notes.title: Hotfix 1.52: Saving Guide and Fix List
notes.notes:
Friends, we have released a hotfix that fixes the problem with launching saves for players who have not purchased DLC-1. However, if the save was created before the update and now does not launch, you can fix it manually. Below is a detailed instruction:

[b]List of fixes in update 1.52:[/b]

• Fixed the error of binding the DLC1 requirement to saves

• Fixed the operation of the inventory and quest log in the PDA

• Fixed the operation of the robotic arm

• Fixed the issuance of rewards for the quest "Cleanliness and Order"

• Fixed Diana's behavior after being refused at the museum

• Fixed the logic for obtaining the "Hipster" achievement.

[b]Instructions for fixing the DLC-1 requirement if it is not purchased:[/b]

1. Go to the folder: C:\Users\*Username*\AppData\LocalLow\ninsar\Saturn\Save

2. Find the desired save file and open it in a text editor (for example, Notepad++).

3. Use the search (Ctrl+F) and find the DLCService section. It will look like this: "DLCService":{"key":"DLCService","data":"[\"Main\",\"DLC1\",\"DLC0\"]"

4. Remove the \"DLC1\" segment from the line

5. Save the changes in the same file (Ctrl+S).

After this, saving should work as usual.

[b]Answers to frequently asked questions about fixing saves[/b]

• Will I have to do this every time?

- No. The cause of the error has been found and fixed. After the update, new saves will work correctly.

• Why can't you fix this automatically?

- Saves are stored locally on players' computers, and we do not have access to them.

• Will this damage other saves?

- No. The changes only affect the selected file. If you need to fix several saves, you need to repeat the procedure for each of them separately.

• Is it possible to disable DLC this way, even if they are purchased?

- We do not recommend doing this. If you started the game with the DLC installed, disabling it may damage the save.

If you have any questions, write in the comments!

We also remind you about the feedback form: https://forms.yandex.ru/u/67215526068ff02b649168f6

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: A large-scale DLC-1 and a major update have been released for Saturn!
notes.notes:
A large-scale DLC-1 and a major update have been released for Saturn: new locations, endings, and dozens of improvements

We are pleased to announce that our Ninsar.Games team is announcing new content and improvements for the game Saturn. On April 24, the release of DLC-1 "Reflection Shards" and a major update for the main game took place.

On October 29, the game became available on VK Play and on our website, and on November 15, the game was released on Steam. On February 6, the release of the free DLC "Fluffy Guest" and the first comic "Ascent" in the universe of the project took place. Today, players can expect two significant updates: DLC-1 "Reflection Shards" and a major update for the main game. This is an important stage in the development of the project: players will receive both a new story arc and improvements to key mechanics. By purchasing DLC-1 before May 9, you get it with a 10% discount!

DLC-1 "Reflection Shards"
The add-on expands the storyline of the incident and introduces a new character - Sylvester Slayton, whose role in what is happening becomes key. In the DLC, players will find:

• 12 new locations, including abandoned complexes and man-made zones

• New opponents and situations adapted to the cyclical mechanics

• 4 new types of weapons that can be obtained as a reward for progress in DLC-1

• A new suit available for completing the main quest

• New endings depending on the decisions made

• Unique dialogues and voiced scenes with key characters

Update to the main game

In parallel with the release of DLC-1, the developers released a major update that affected almost all aspects of the game:

Gameplay and balance:
• Reworked movement mechanics

• Improved enemy AI in combat

• Adjusted the balance of status effects and perks

• Improved the system of interaction with bodies

• Adjusted the balance of items and trade

• Improved weapon sounds

• Added the ability to interrupt actions, fixed zones attacks

Plot and events:
• 10 new side quests

• 20 random events

• Improved quest logic (for example, now Chong Ju correctly issues a pass, and Gavrilov does not get lost along the way)

• Updated and expanded voice acting from “GamesVoice”

• Added new reactions of the main character to what is happening

Graphics and performance:
• Implemented location optimization

• Added SSAO, anti-aliasing settings

• Added three camera tracking settings: constant tracking, disabling tracking in combat and completely disabling tracking

As well as hundreds of other changes in quests, dialogues, interactive objects, interfaces, achievements and visuals. The developers emphasize that this update is the result of feedback from players accumulated since the release, and a step towards the next stage of the project's development.

Each of you has the opportunity to support our project by purchasing the “Supporter Kit” with a 10% discount, which includes DLC-0, DLC-1, the original soundtrack and a comic about the game universe.

notes.title: Fresh patch for Saturn - fixes, improvements, improvements!
notes.notes:
We continue to work on the game, fixing bugs and improving the mechanics. In this update:

- The first iteration of the random vignette system has been implemented (as well as the vignettes themselves)
- Improved loot system — now there are no empty corpses and loot will spawn randomly in many places.
- Fixed the display of the clothing section in the inventory
- Fixed the door to Professor Gavrilov's house.
- Fixed the work of NPCs in the "Hero of this City" quest
- Fixed the ability to use PDAs and battle buttons during vignettes, dialogues, and cutscenes.
- Improved task status display in the PDA
- Improved the display of messages in the PDA 
- The ability to roll outside of combat is disabled
- Fixed the work of removing the effects of Altai tea
- The robot counter on the global map is disabled
- Fixed the display of stats when leveling skills 
- Disabled the possibility of vignettes appearing in battle
- Illumination of interactive objects causing vignettes is disabled.
- The trading menu has been improved 
- Fixed a bug where Diana ran away from the museum before completing the dialogue.
- Fixed the stun bug after loading the game
- Added the ability to close the backpack with Esc

As well as dozens of other changes to graphics, texts, interfaces, game logic, and other aspects of the game.

We do not plan to stop and continue to refine the game and introduce new content. Expect announcements soon!

notes.title: The first comic book "Ascension" and the mysterious "Fluffy Guest"
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that our Ninsar.Games team is announcing new content and improvements for the Saturn game. On February 6, the free DLC "Fluffy Guest" and the first "Ascension" comic book were released in the project's universe.

On October 29, the game became available on VK Play and on our website, and on November 15, the game was released on Steam. Today, players will receive two significant updates: the free DLC "Fluffy Guest" and the first comic "Ascension" in the universe of the project, revealing the background of the main events of the game.

[b]DLC "Fluffy Guest"[/b]
We are pleased to present you the free DLC "Fluffy Guest", in which you will meet a new companion — a red cat! This furry friend will not only become your faithful companion in the fight to save humanity, but will also require care and attention. Don't forget to feed him!

"[I]The free DLC-0 for Saturn is essentially a small element before the large-scale DLC-1. And yes, it's about a ginger cat that needs to be fed. After all, all cats love to eat delicious food. Even virtual ones," Denis Dorokhov, game director of the Saturn game, said.

[b]The first Ascension comic
[/b]
The game company Ninsar Games expands the universe of the Saturn game, which tells about the events of Russia in the future in 2062. In the first comic, readers will immerse themselves in the story of a young Dmitry Gavrilov, who discovers the threads of the ether, a technology that will allow human operators to connect to machines on distant planets of the Solar system.

Five episodes, set from 2033 to 2050, will tell the story of this discovery. In 2033, Gavrilov is alone against the whole world: the academic community does not trust him, but he receives unexpected help. In 2035, Gavrilov enters into a confrontation with AI, which is connected to human consciousness through the threads of the ether. In 2037, Akim Kovalev, a graduate student of Gavrilov, manages to find the missing link that allows connecting a person to a car. This is how Reflection was born, a remote robot control system familiar to us from the Saturn game.

The comic will be available in Russian and English and will be paid for. 

[b]Other updates
[/b]
In addition, the developers continue to work on improving the game. The new update has fixed bugs and improved mechanics. For example, added "[b]Story mode [/b]", which will allow you not to start over after each death.

And now [b] achievements in VK Play and Steam are supported[/b], which will give you the opportunity to receive rewards as you progress!

notes.title: A new patch is available in Saturn!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800326/518bb862ee057cc534a81753ef27fa1491424ec5.jpg[/img]
We've released a new patch for Saturn that adds new features and improvements to make your gaming experience even better.

What will be in the patch:

1. Easy mod. After death, the player can either restart the cycle or start with the last save.

2. Rebalance of status effects. Many status effects have been redesigned in terms of duration, so that their effects (and benefits) are felt not only in combat, but also in peacetime.

3. Processing randomness in vignettes. Now the luck indicator affects many random events, especially if luck is not pumped at all.

4. Random loot. Now a random reward appears in many boxes and robots.

5. Modification of the combat system. A somersault was added to the akim for greater mobility and the ability to get out of any mess.

6. New Year decorations. A Christmas tree, an olive tree, garlands and other attributes of the New Year mood appeared in the Akim's house.

7. The museum has new exhibits.

8. We are improving localizations in English and Chinese.

The update is already available! Launch the game and evaluate the improvements.

notes.title: Saturn now has voice acting from GamesVoice!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44800326/9254bf111b61b52e2bf0f4830e0307deb056c9a0.jpg[/img]
The game features new voice acting created by GamesVoice. The game's heroes have acquired the voices of Thor, Scarlet Witch, Johnny Silverhand and other legendary characters. The amount of work is comparable to the duration of three full-length films!

Characters who have received voice acting:

Akim Kovalev - a slightly melancholic, but stubborn and determined protagonist. Voiced by Ilya Bledny, who previously voiced Johnny Silverhand from the game "Cyberpunk 2077".

David Dvorkin - Akim's childhood friend, a cheerful big guy, but a terrible curmudgeon who will not give even a friend a discount on his goods. He was voiced by Ivan Zharkov, who voices Thor from the Marvel films.

Andrey Lykov - a lively guy who values ​​high waves in the sea almost as much as science. His voice was provided by Gleb Gavrilov, who previously voiced Joffrey Baratheon from the Game of Thrones series.

Elena is a famous pop singer who traded the Reflection capsule for the stage in the past. She was voiced by Ulyana Chebotar, who voiced June Mindy from the film Don't Look Up.

Wang Shi is the head of the ARKA space research department. Over the years of working in Russia, she already speaks Russian without an accent. Her voice was provided by Anna Kisileva, who previously voiced the Scarlet Witch from the Marvel films.

Chong Ju is the head of the largest department of the Chinese Huangdi in Russia, Sochi, a stern and pedantic manager. He has learned Russian perfectly, but in moments of excitement, an accent sometimes slips through. He was voiced by Danil Shcheblanov, who voices Ryan Gosling.

Professor Gavrilov is the creator of the "Reflection" program, a charismatic but very harmful former mentor of Akim, who values ​​high science and the attention and awards that come with it, but thinks little about the people around him. His voice was provided by Alexander Matrosov, who previously voiced Lobo from the game "Resident Evil 8".

And the mysterious Diana, who knows more than she tells Akim... Her secrets will have to be revealed to players, getting to know her better in the game itself. She was voiced by Christina Sherman, who voiced the Twins from the game "Atomic Heart".

The free project was made possible thanks to funding from the IRI, and you can support the developers by purchasing an exclusive soundtrack.

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere with professional voice acting and a new trailer, find out what secrets "Saturn" hides!
